name: @familiar/desktop-tauri
description: Familiar desktop shell (Tauri): the system webview + a bundled Node sidecar. A size-optimized alternative to the Electron shell (packages/desktop); see docs/spec/06-roadmap.md.

scripts.build:linux: node scripts/stage.mjs && cargo tauri build --bundles deb,appimage
scripts.build:win: node scripts/stage.mjs && cargo tauri build --bundles nsis
